name: Antarctica and South Georgia Air-Cruise
flight: One way. Fly South 2026-27 and 2027-28: fly Punta Arenas to King George Island, sail to Ushuaia. Fly North 2027-28: sail from Ushuaia, fly back to Punta Arenas. 2028-29: Punta Arenas round trip.

seo.title: Antarctica and South Georgia Air-Cruise: 18 Days
seo.description: Fly from Punta Arenas to Antarctica, explore the Peninsula, then sail to South Georgia's king penguins and on to Ushuaia. Antarctica21, 18 days, March.

tagline: Fly in, sail out: the Peninsula, Elephant Island and South Georgia.
answer: The Antarctica and South Georgia Air-Cruise is Antarctica21's eighteen-day, seventeen-night voyage. Guests fly from Punta Arenas to King George Island, explore the Antarctic Peninsula, pass Elephant Island, spend four days at South Georgia including Grytviken and St Andrews Bay, then sail to Ushuaia. It runs in March on 88-guest Magellan ships.
overview: The longest Antarctica21 air-cruise. Four days on the Peninsula, Elephant Island seen from the ship, then four days at South Georgia with its king penguin colonies and Shackleton's grave at Grytviken, before the crossing to the Beagle Channel.

gallery.alt: A fur seal in the Antarctic landscape

itinerary.title: Start of the air-cruise
itinerary.summary: Arrive in Punta Arenas and transfer to the hotel. Check in at Explorers House before 2 PM for the mandatory briefing, then the welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Scheduled flight to Antarctica
itinerary.place: King George Island, South Shetland Islands
itinerary.summary: A flight of about two hours to King George Island. Guests walk past Chile's Frei Station and Russia's Bellingshausen Station to the shore, then board the ship by Zodiac.

itinerary.title: Exploring Antarctica
itinerary.place: South Shetland Islands and Antarctic Peninsula
itinerary.summary: Daily Zodiac landings and lectures; possible sites in the Gerlache Strait, Penola Strait and Antarctic Sound.
itinerary.label: Days 3 to 6

itinerary.title: Elephant Island
itinerary.summary: Seen from the ship; a landing is unlikely.

itinerary.title: At sea toward South Georgia
itinerary.summary: Historian and naturalist presentations on the way north.
itinerary.label: Days 8 to 9

itinerary.title: South Georgia
itinerary.place: Grytviken, St Andrews Bay, Cooper Island
itinerary.summary: Grytviken and Shackleton's grave, St Andrews Bay and Cooper Island; Fortuna Bay, Salisbury Plain, Drygalski Fjord and Elsehul Bay if the weather allows.
itinerary.label: Days 10 to 13

itinerary.title: At sea toward South America
itinerary.summary: Presentations on board during the crossing.
itinerary.label: Days 14 to 16

itinerary.title: Beagle Channel
itinerary.summary: Sailing past Tierra del Fuego and Navarino Island.

faqs: Do you land at South Georgia?
Yes. Antarctica21 plans four days there, including Grytviken, St Andrews Bay and Cooper Island, with more sites if the weather allows.
Antarctica21 says a landing is unlikely; it is seen from the ship.
Fly South in 2026-27 and 2027-28 (fly to Antarctica, sail to Ushuaia). A Fly North version is also listed for 2027-28.
What happens if weather delays the flight?

Antarctica21 flies only when King George Island weather allows. Outbound, it keeps trying from Day 1 until 2 PM on Day 4, with Punta Arenas tours, meals and the Day 1 hotel covered while guests wait. If guests still cannot fly by then, the trip is cancelled and Antarctica21 refunds 100% of the cruise fare. On the way back, the ship keeps cruising until the flight is cleared, or guests fly up to a day early.
